lines.zh: 我悬在半空，翅膀快得看不清
lines.en: I hover, wings too fast to see.

lines.zh: 黄黑的身子只有半格大
lines.en: My yellow-black body is barely half a block.

lines.zh: 我绕着你侧飞，保持距离
lines.en: I fly at your flank, keeping my distance.

lines.zh: 翅膀响得像一根拉紧的弦
lines.en: My wings whine like a taut string.
I drift back, then forward again.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你脚边打转
lines.en: My shadow wheels around your feet.

lines.zh: 我在草叶上方一尺悬着。
lines.en: I hover a foot above the grass blades.
My stinger points down, always at you.
I turn in the air.
Too fast. I slow down.
I hover in little fits and starts.
My compound eyes are full of your shape.
I swing to your other side.
The air shivers where I pass.
I drop back two blocks. Just right.
When my wings stop, I drop.

lines.zh: 我悬停着，翅膀扇得很轻
lines.en: I hover, beating my wings softly.
Once you move, I move.
The distance is right. No need to back off.

lines.zh: 我的弹幕已经准备好了
lines.en: My shot is ready.

lines.zh: 风把我的身子吹偏一点
lines.en: The wind nudges me sideways.
My eyes hold many of you.

lines.zh: 我不落地，落下来太危险
lines.en: I don't land. Landing is too risky.
My stinger rests under my abdomen.

lines.zh: 这片地方我绕着飞了几圈
lines.en: I've circled this patch a few times.
I'm measuring your height.
The hum drops a little.

lines.zh: 你的手抬到哪我跟到哪
lines.en: Wherever your hand goes, I follow.
I hover before you and stop.
You're much bigger than I expected.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛看得到你身后
lines.en: My eyes see behind you too.
You raise a hand; I rise.
At this range I can hit you.

lines.zh: 我的尾针朝你转了一点
lines.en: My stinger turns toward you.
You have no wings. Good.
And I don't mean to come close.
We're both waiting.
Then let's see who breaks first.
The hit sends me spinning.

lines.zh: 翅膀有一片不太听使唤
lines.en: One wing won't quite obey.
I drop a block and climb again.
I'm too small to take much.
My hum has changed its note.
I retreat further out.
My stinger is a little bent.

lines.zh: 这一下差点把我打落地
lines.en: That nearly knocked me down.

lines.zh: 我的嗡声低了一截，还在飞。
lines.en: My buzz drops an octave; I keep flying.
But not for much longer.
What is it you're holding up?
I'm not here to eat.
That smell has nothing to do with me.
You lift a hand; I back off a block.
That won't draw a hornet.

lines.zh: 那不是花蜜，我掉头离开。
lines.en: That is not nectar; I turn away.
I won't touch it, nor come near.
What would you trade it for?
My target is you, not that.
You'd better put that away.

lines.zh: 你碰了我一下，我翻了半圈
lines.en: You bump me and I tumble half a turn.
A wing tips and I drop a block.
I steady and back away.
That has annoyed me.
I'm light. Bumping me won't hurt you.
I graze past your hand.

lines.zh: 我的翅尖扫过你的下巴
lines.en: My wingtip brushes your chin.
I retreat, still watching you.
I need to re-measure the distance.
Closer and I strike first.
There are many of our kind.

lines.zh: 不用靠太近也能一起飞
lines.en: We can fly together without crowding.

lines.zh: 我保持这个距离，才安全。
lines.en: This distance keeps me safe.
Our wingbeats should match.
I don't land. Neither do you.
Don't collide while we circle.
Keep the stinger in. Don't point it.
The nest is high over there.
One block apart suits us.
Let's fly a stretch like this.
I drop and snatch it up.
Too heavy. I can't lift it.
Carrying it, I fly crooked.
This can be carried back to the hive.
You dropped it; I saw it first.
My legs are too thin to grip it.
I drop it and take something smaller.
I only take what's useful.
Not heavy. All right.
Once I have it, I climb.
I stop two blocks out.
My wings surge.
This distance lets me hit you.
My stinger swings forward.
First, one shot sent your way.
Don't try to close the gap.
Come closer and I retreat.
I circle you in the air.

lines.zh: 我的尾针捏准了你的肩。
lines.en: My stinger takes aim at your shoulder.
I've got your height worked out.
Don't think you'll slip past me.
Then it starts with this blow.
I circle above you.
Wherever you go, I take that side.
I stay two blocks away.
Angle set. Firing.
My shot flies straight.
Can you hear the hum?
It's always on your left.
And now I'm on the right.
You can block one. Two?
I hover at the edge of your sight.

lines.zh: 我只有三点生命，却会飞着咬。
lines.en: Three health, but I bite in flight.
Then let's do it now.
I dive, stinger first.
That strikes your bracer.
I hit and fall back out.
My wings fan wind in your face.
A dot left on your armour.
I climb back out to two blocks.
This shot comes from the side.
You turn; I've already moved.
I won't trade blows with you.

lines.zh: 挨一下就退，这是我的打法
lines.en: Hit once, retreat. That's my way.

lines.zh: 我在半空出现，翅膀还在响
lines.en: I appear mid-air, wings still whining.
This isn't my biome.
I was released here.

lines.zh: 我在两格高的地方停住
lines.en: I stop at two blocks up.
The wind here suits me.
I sweep the area and find you.

lines.zh: 我的身子小，很容易漏看
lines.en: I'm small and easy to overlook.
My wings give my position away.
I don't land. I begin at once.

lines.zh: 细小的嗡声先到我，然后是我。
lines.en: A thin buzz arrives before I do.
Flame curls the edge of my wing.

lines.zh: 翅膀沾了土，我扑不起来。
lines.en: Dust on my wings; I cannot lift off.
Wings soaked, I can't stay up.
The blast throws me blocks away.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过翅膀，飞不稳。
lines.en: An arrow through my wing — I can't fly straight.
The light numbs my wing membrane.
Too starved to beat my wings well.
At the thunderclap I plummet.

lines.zh: 下面是空的，我抓不住任何东西
lines.en: Nothing below. I catch nothing.
